title: Isandro and the Thorn
premise: Wendell Almeida, an exiled storm-caller hiding in a valley where magic cannot follow, discovers their date with Isandro Veyra—a quiet bookbinder—was foretold in a century-old prophecy. A thorn of corrupted magic drags them both into the fractured realms beyond the valley, where they must reforge a broken covenant between human and fae worlds before the thorn devours memory itself. Along the way Wendell learns their exile was self-chosen to bury a catastrophic act they no longer remember, and Isandro is revealed as the prophecy's original scribe, bound across time. In the end, Wendell sacrifices their recovered memories to seal the covenant, choosing to build a new identity with Isandro rather than reclaim the old one.
about_author: Casper Sterling is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing rare grimoires before turning to fiction. They write stories about people who find themselves in places—and books—they never meant to enter.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: POV Wendell. Wendell prepares for a first date with Isandro, nervously navigating life in the magic-dead valley where exiles go to be forgotten. Emotional beat: tentative hope shadowed by the ache of not knowing why they were exiled.

chapters.title: Ink That Wasn't There Yesterday
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. While restoring an antique prophecy book, Isandro finds fresh ink describing tonight's date in uncanny detail—including his own name beside Wendell's. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into dread as the text begins rewriting itself.

chapters.title: Pulled Through the Page
chapters.summary: POV Wendell. Mid-date, the prophecy activates; a thorn of black bramble erupts from the book and drags them both into the Sundered Realms. Emotional beat: terror and reluctant exhilaration as Wendell's storm-magic stirs for the first time in years.

chapters.title: The Court of Broken Oaths
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The pair reaches the fae court, learning the covenant binding realms was shattered a century ago, unleashing the memory-eating Thorn. Emotional beat: Isandro hides that the prophecy's handwriting is his own.

chapters.title: What the Storm Remembers
chapters.summary: POV Wendell. Crossing the Ashmoor, fragments of Wendell's erased past surface with each storm they call—their exile was punishment for a betrayal they can't yet face. Emotional beat: grief and self-doubt threatening their resolve.

chapters.title: The Scribe's Confession
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Cornered by the Thorn, Isandro admits he wrote the prophecy a hundred years ago; his soul was bound into the book as payment. Emotional beat: raw vulnerability, and Wendell's fury at being a means to an end.

chapters.title: Thornfall
chapters.summary: POV Wendell. The Thorn assaults the last free city, devouring its collective memories; Wendell must choose between fleeing to safety or fighting with full, dangerous power. Emotional beat: defiant commitment—they will not run again.

chapters.title: The Price of the Covenant
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. At the Covenant Forge, they learn reforging requires a living memory freely given—but Isandro's are already spent, leaving only Wendell's newly recovered past. Emotional beat: agonizing choice, love against identity.

chapters.title: Stormheart
chapters.summary: POV Wendell. Climax: Wendell channels every remembered storm into the Forge while Isandro anchors them against the Thorn's final assault, sacrificing their memories mid-reforge. Emotional beat: transcendent loss—giving up the self to save both worlds.

chapters.title: A Book With Blank Pages
chapters.summary: POV alternating. The covenant holds; back in the valley, Wendell remembers nothing but chooses Isandro anyway, finding belonging not in the past but in what they build next. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace—an ending that is also a beginning.
